findings.passage: “Photo ID is a common-sense safeguard that the people of Southwest Wisconsin appreciate and want to see continue as part of a secure election process in our state,” said Rep. Tranel. “It should be easy to vote but hard to cheat, and that's why this amendment should be adopted by the voters.”
findings.note: Official Assembly press release the day the Assembly passed the photo ID constitutional amendment resolution 54-45. He is quoted supporting the amendment.

findings.passage: State Representative Travis Tranel (R-Cuba City), who has supported photo ID legislation during his tenure in office, was happy to cast his vote for the resolution approving the amendment, which passed 54-45.
findings.note: Same release (written by his office) states he has backed photo ID legislation throughout his time in office and voted for the amendment resolution.
